title: SREV-156 dump DbgHelp entry and client pointers

loader_shape.description: GetProcAddress result is checked before use

exception_pointer_shape.description: in-process exception pointers use ClientPointers FALSE

contracts: GetProcAddress returns NULL on failure and MiniDumpWriteDump must not be called through a NULL function pointer
Dump_Init must not install Dump_CrashHandlerExceptionFilter unless MiniDumpWriteDump is resolved
failed MiniDumpWriteDump resolution frees Dump_DbgHelpMod clears the module handle and returns 0
Dump_CrashHandlerExceptionFilter must guard the function-pointer call before MiniDumpWriteDump
MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION.ClientPointers is FALSE for local exception pointers in the calling process
this SREV does not change MiniDumpFlags dump file path SetUnhandledExceptionFilter blocking policy or in-process dump architecture
the Linux source gate is not Windows runtime proof
